title.zh: OKX推出OKX Money，已覆盖逾30个国家
title.en: OKX推出OKX Money，已覆盖逾30个国家

current_state.zh: OKX unveiled OKX Money, a standalone self-custodial finance app built on X Layer offering transfers, spending, savings and asset custody across more than 30 countries, with Aave-backed Pay Boost for European users and planned AI-driven investment features.
current_state.en: OKX unveiled OKX Money, a standalone self-custodial finance app built on X Layer offering transfers, spending, savings and asset custody across more than 30 countries, with Aave-backed Pay Boost for European users and planned AI-driven investment features.
